senses.gloss: Vaydabber (and he spoke), name of the Fourth Book of Moses, Numbers.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 64:8">Ib.</cite> <he>עביד ו׳ תלתא וכ׳</he> divided the Book of Numbers into three books.
<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 4:11">Yalk. Gen. 4</cite> <he>ספר ו׳</he> (<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 3">Gen. R. s. 3</cite> <cite ref="B00924"><he>בְּמִדְבַּר</he></cite>).
